_how_to_use: Add a note by appending an object to entries: date (YYYY-MM-DD), kind (decision | note | limitation), title, body, and evidence (the file, commit or test that backs it). The Knowledge base tab lists them newest first. Never put secrets here - this repo is public.

entries.title: The Command Center reads the plan at runtime
entries.body: Every tab fetches .colaberry/plan.json, progress.json and manifest.json when it loads. No project content is typed into the page, so a sync updates it without a code change.

entries.title: The data model is read from the backend, not designed on paper
entries.body: The Data model tab lists every durable store the backend actually writes, with the fields seen in code. They are keyed JSON stores today, not SQL tables.

entries.title: There is no customer entity
entries.body: Bookings, payments, quotes and sessions all carry a customerId, but no store holds customers, so nothing defines what a customerId refers to.
